definitions: perturbationSize D r := (2 * opNorm D / (1-r^2)) * r^2
perturbationRatio D r := opNorm(D^-1) * perturbationSize D r
inverseGain D r := opNorm(D^-1) / (1-perturbationRatio D r)
inverseErrorConstant D r := opNorm(D^-1)*opNorm D / ((1-perturbationRatio D r)*(1-r^2))
coefficientEstimate D beta := exactEstimate (coefficientMatrix D beta) (dipoleMap D beta)
exact_lean_target_signatures: theorem matrix_inverse_perturbation (D A : M3) (hdet : Matrix.det D ≠ 0) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) (hpert : opNorm (A-D) ≤ eps) (hsmall : opNorm (D⁻¹)*eps < 1) : Matrix.det A ≠ 0 ∧ opNorm (A⁻¹) ≤ opNorm (D⁻¹)/(1-opNorm (D⁻¹)*eps)

theorem coefficientMatrix_inverse_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (hdet : Matrix.det D ≠ 0) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) (hsmall : perturbationRatio D r < 1) : Matrix.det (coefficientMatrix D beta) ≠ 0 ∧ opNorm ((coefficientMatrix D beta)⁻¹) ≤ inverseGain D r

theorem coefficientMatrix_inverse_difference_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (hdet : Matrix.det D ≠ 0) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) (hsmall : perturbationRatio D r < 1) : opNorm ((coefficientMatrix D beta)⁻¹ - D⁻¹) ≤ (2*opNorm (D⁻¹)^2*opNorm D / ((1-perturbationRatio D r)*(1-r^2))) * eNorm beta^2

theorem coefficient_inverse_defect (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) (hA : Matrix.det (coefficientMatrix D beta) ≠ 0) : beta - coefficientEstimate D beta = timeCoefficient D beta • ((coefficientMatrix D beta)⁻¹).mulVec beta

theorem coefficient_inverse_error_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (hdet : Matrix.det D ≠ 0) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) (hsmall : perturbationRatio D r < 1) : eNorm (beta-coefficientEstimate D beta) ≤ inverseErrorConstant D r * eNorm beta^3 ∧ eNorm (beta-coefficientEstimate D beta) ≤ (r*inverseErrorConstant D r)*eNorm beta^2
theorem explicit_admissible_radius (D : M3) : 0 < admissibleRadius D ∧ admissibleRadius D < 1 ∧ perturbationRatio D (admissibleRadius D) < 1

theorem zeroH_coefficient_inverse_control : let D := CAS03C03.zeroHD; let r := admissibleRadius D; CAS03C03.H D = 0 ∧ Matrix.det D = -2 ∧ 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧ perturbationRatio D r < 1 ∧ ∀ beta : V3, eNorm beta ≤ r → Matrix.det (coefficientMatrix D beta) ≠ 0

coefficientMatrix D beta *v beta = -(1/2) • dipoleMap D beta + timeCoefficient D beta • beta
|timeCoefficient D beta| ≤ opNorm D/(1-r^2) * eNorm beta^2 on the radius-r ball
opNorm (coefficientMatrix D beta-D) ≤ perturbationSize D r on the radius-r ball
eNorm (M.mulVec v) ≤ opNorm M * eNorm v
finite-dimensional mulVec injectivity iff determinant nonzero
